subject: MAP: Orbital Health - Deployment mode recommendation and cutover runway
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana.lee@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Draft deployment recommendation and evaluation plan (Orbital Health)

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the thoughtful discovery last week. Attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the evaluation checklist we discussed (MAP_OrbitalHealth_v1.xlsx). TL;DR recommendation from our side: aim for a hybrid approach — Dedicated capacity for PHI-sensitive inference (internal clinical models) and Hosted for lower-risk batch/analytics workloads to balance cost and SLA.

Rationale (short):
- Dedicated (US-east) gives predictable latency and the isolation you need for credentialed clinical traffic and helps with auditability for your compliance team.
- Hosted can be used for non-PHI batch jobs (embeddings, analytics) to reduce committed spend up front while we validate performance.
- We suggest an initial canary in us-east-1 for 2 weeks, then staged rollout across production zones.

Key asks for the next week:
1) Confirm target go-live window (we suggested Aug 10–Sep 4 in the MAP worksheet).
2) Provide the list of test datasets you want included in the eval (sensitive vs non-sensitive).
3) Procurement contact for contract and pricing alignment.

I've included a short evaluation plan in the spreadsheet that maps metrics (p95 latency, token cost, error rate, functional regressions) to owners and acceptance gates. Also attached is a separate SOC2 Q&A doc requested by your security team (SOC2-questions-answers.pdf).

I'll coordinate internal owners once you confirm the test sets. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the MAP.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: MAP_OrbitalHealth_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 220KB)
Attachment: SOC2-questions-answers.pdf (pdf, 180KB)
From: Dana Lee <dana.lee@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@orbitalhealth.com>, procurement@orbitalhealth.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Draft deployment recommendation and evaluation plan (Orbital Health)

Thanks Lukas — this is helpful. A few clarifying Qs from security and procurement before we lock the MAP: 

1) For Dedicated: can you confirm whether dedicated instances can be restricted to our VPC with customer-managed KMS? Our security team requires this for PHI.
2) For Hosted: what SLA and data retention guarantees apply to non-PHI logs? We need to ensure retention is at least 90 days and logs can be exported.
3) The evaluation datasets: Miguel will share the list tomorrow. Can you add a token-level cost estimate for the evaluation runs (sample 100k tokens)?

Also — procurement asked if you can provide a rough committed cost range for a 6-month Dedicated pilot (Nvidia A100 equivalent, baseline throughput 1200 tokens/sec). A ballpark number is fine for now; we'll need formal quote later.

Can we do a quick 20-min call Wednesday 7/1?

Best,
Dana
Orbital Health — Director, Digital Platforms
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana.lee@orbitalhealth.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Draft deployment recommendation and evaluation plan (Orbital Health)

Hi Dana — happy to take the procurement/commit question. Quick answers: 

- Dedicated + VPC/KMS: yes — Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS and VPC peering for on-prem/VPC deployments. We'll capture the exact network ACLs in the MAP appendix.
- Hosted logs/retention: hosted endpoints can be configured to retain logs for 90/180 days; we will add an export hook to S3 (or your preferred HTTP webhook) so you can archive raw logs.
- Pricing: for a 6-month dedicated pilot at the throughput you listed (1200 tps baseline), ballpark committed cost range is $85k–$120k/month depending on exact GPU SKU and support level. This assumes a burst policy for peak days. We'll provide a formal quote via procurement and a DocuSign link once terms are agreed.

Alternative proposal (to reduce upfront commit): start with a 3-month Dedicated pilot focused on clinical surface area + Hosted for the rest. That reduces committed spend and gives time to validate canary SLA under load.

Next steps I propose for the MAP:
- Add a split-run evaluation (Dedicated vs Hosted) for the same test set to compare p95 and cost.
- Owner assignments: Lukas (technical lead/canary), Mina (security compliance), Aditya (cost model & billing), Laura (procurement).

Assigning actions in the MAP worksheet now; Lukas — can you confirm the canary window availability for the week of Aug 10?

Laura Bennett
Head of Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Lee <dana.lee@orbitalhealth.com>, procurement@orbitalhealth.com
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Draft deployment recommendation and evaluation plan (Orbital Health)

Appreciate the clear options. Quick notes from the engineering side: 

- We prefer Dedicated for the real-time triage API (latency bound). Hosted is OK for nightly batch embeddings. If Dedicated price for 6 months is at the lower end of your ballpark ($85k/mo) we can make a case to leadership for a 6-month pilot.
- Canary: we want the canary in us-east-1 (close to our main region) and will run functional + load tests. 2-week canary OK but we may request a 1-week extension if we hit regressions.
- Timeline: target internal sign-off week of Jul 27, procurement signature Aug 7, canary Aug 10–Aug 24, full traffic by Sep 6 if all gates pass.

Can you add an explicit rollback criterion to the MAP (p95 > 350ms OR error rate > 0.8%)? That will help us operationally.

Miguel
Engineering Manager, Orbital Health
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@orbitalhealth.com>, Dana Lee <dana.lee@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, procurement@orbitalhealth.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Draft deployment recommendation and evaluation plan (Orbital Health)

Thanks all — summarizing the agreed MAP updates and next steps so it's explicit: 

1) Deployment mode decision: Hybrid. Dedicated (VPC + customer KMS) for real-time PHI traffic; Hosted for non-PHI batch/analytics. (Owner: Lukas)
2) Canary window: Aug 10–Aug 24 in us-east-1. We will provide a staging endpoint and run the split-run evaluation (Dedicated vs Hosted) mapped in the MAP spreadsheet. (Owner: Lukas)
3) Rollback gates: p95 > 350ms OR error rate > 0.8% during canary => immediate rollback to the previous model/variant and pause ramp. (Owner: Miguel + Redwood on-call)
4) Procurement and pricing: Laura to send formal quote and DocuSign by Jul 10 EOD. Procurement to aim to sign by Aug 7. (Owner: Laura / procurement)
5) Security/compliance: Mina to provide configuration checklist for VPC/KMS and an audit log export runbook by Jul 17. (Owner: Mina)
6) Evaluation metrics & datasets: Miguel to share dataset list by Jul 6. Redwood to produce token-cost estimate for 100k tokens by Jul 7. (Owners: Miguel / Aditya)

Action items completed in this email: Laura — please confirm you attached the formal quote to the DocuSign link once it's ready. Aditya — I'll need the token-cost estimate and a short pricing sensitivity table (hosted vs dedicated) by Jul 7 so we can finalize the MAP. Mina — please drop the security checklist into the Drive folder and ping Dana.

We will also add the rollback criteria into the MAP worksheet and highlight the canary gates. Attaching the updated MAP (v1.1) to the Drive link; will push the version into the spreadsheet after we get Miguel's datasets.

If that summary looks right I'll schedule the 30-min MAP walkthrough for Tue Jul 13 (propose 10:00am PT).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Lukas Meyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0189
